message.content: The kernel is a FP32 Cephes-style atan with coefficients truncated to only 4–5 significant digits, under a strict 1e-6 absolute tolerance across every finite FP16 value. That truncation is the dominant risk: coefficient rounding error alone in a degree-4/4 rational form is plausibly orders of magnitude larger than 1e-6. I'll record the highest-risk, directly testable claims.
